required_positive_signals: EF_SHARES_ALL_BLOCKS on both distinct same-volume files

superseded_observation: Foundation fileContentIdentifier distinguished one tested clone from an independent rewrite, but is not admitted as security evidence because the volume does not advertise full clone mapping.
interpretation: The pinned native bridge is implemented and adversarially tests its decision predicate and fail-closed paths. This host cannot produce positive full-clone evidence, so clone provenance remains unverified; no negative result is treated as confinement proof.
